newsitem.title: UK: Cowie says overall trading remains strong.
newsitem.headline: Cowie says overall trading remains strong.

text.p: UK leasing-to-bus company Cowie Group Plc said on Thursday the group's overall trading performance remains strong.
Chairman Sir James McKinnon told the annual meeting that all core divisions continue to provide a solid foundation for growth.
He said the strong performance seen by the group's London bus companies last year has continued into 1997.
He added that the bus and coach distribution division was operating ahead of the first quarter position last year.
The finance division continues to maintain strong levels of fleet growth with 1,150 units added in the first quarter of this year, the company said in a statement.
The motor division was also performing ahead of last year.
